rows.comment: implementations on a pure-virtual base method reaches every cross-file override, via the INHERITS_INV descendant walk over the pack children reverse index (the leveldb Iterator::Seek gap: base-class relations were captured into package_parents but never wired into the pack index's children map). oval.cc's override sits on a QUALIFIED nested subclass (Shapes::OvalShape), exercising the qualified-name base-class-clause capture.

implementations on a base CLASS token lists its concrete subclasses (the INHERITS_INV descendants' class defs), edge-gated so an unrelated same-named nested class never leaks in on bare-name identity (the leveldb SkipList::Iterator false positive). Includes the qualified nested subclass Shapes::OvalShape.
